definitions.aggregates: an aggregate statement (the *.aggregate entries) combines per-tier verdicts and has no point estimate, so its rows in comparison_with_the_record.never_scored and in changes carry null for mean_difference and the CI ends; so does every statement whose numbers hold no mean_difference and no contrast (BRIEF_45 Amendment D, D1.2 and D1.5)
definitions.arithmetic_route: one route everywhere, the registered one: numpy.mean per draw (a plain left-to-right sum over five seeds) and mean_ci95 over the draws.  P8.4b's att_rederivation._per_draw_means and tier_sweep.score_stop_rule use Python's built-in sum (compensated on Python 3.12), which can differ in the last place; comparison_with_the_record names each such difference, reproduces the record by its own route (BRIEF_45 Amendment A, A2 Q1) and refuses a difference larger than 4 ulps of the larger magnitude (Amendment B, B2.5)
definitions.att_engine: the engine's average travel time of the same episodes, re-derived by deterministic replay (P8.4b's campaign; P5.2b's re-derivation for the corrected cell)
definitions.att_ours: P5.2's att_horizon: the platform's average travel time at the horizon, read from the evaluation records (P5.1's, P5.2's and P5.2b's)
definitions.changes_flags: changes[*].changed_by_the_correction (as committed -> corrected, att_ours) and changed_by_rule_r (corrected att_ours -> corrected att_engine) are true iff the verdict or the reading differs between the two steps; they compare verdicts and readings, not values, so a value may move without either flag (BRIEF_45 Amendment D, D1.5)

common_scoring.text: Primary metric `att_horizon` (A1). Paired unit = per-draw mean over the 5 seeds across the 100 shared held-out draws (`dt_gate._per_draw_means`). Interval = the 95 % CI of the mean paired difference (`mean_ci95`, `ddof=1`, `1.96 σ/√n`). Lower ATT is better. Every outcome is one of HELD / FAILED / NOT RESOLVED, and `NOT RESOLVED` is always reported with the CI width rather than folded into either neighbour.

d15.carried: each cell's median and IQR per definition (numpy.percentile, method='linear') and A5's horizon vehicle count, asserted equal to each evaluation record's own cell block

quotes.text: every arm reports median, IQR and `vehicle_count` at the horizon (A5, unconditional), and any arm whose distribution is visibly not unimodal is reported with the distributional comparison beside its mean

d8.carried: rank_biserial, median_difference, wins, losses, ties and the Wilcoxon block from offline_baselines.paired_comparison, unchanged; the p-value is never read by a verdict. rank_biserial_defined and rank_biserial_note label the effect size, and p_value_defined and p_value_note label the test: both are wilcoxon.n_used > 0, so where every per-draw difference is exactly zero the signed-rank test is empty and its z = 0.0 and p_value = 1.0 are dt_gate.wilcoxon_signed_rank's convention, not a result (BRIEF_45 Amendment B.2, B.2.3); where 0 < n_used < 20 the defined note also says the normal approximation rests on fewer pairs than the n >= 20 its function's docstring states (Amendment D, D1.8)

quotes.text: Every pair reports a paired difference, a CI, the CI width and a rank-biserial; no verdict string.

definitions.exact_zero: a difference identically zero on every draw has CI [0, 0] and sign zero, and the registered rule decides the verdict (BRIEF_45 Amendment B, B2.1): NOT RESOLVED for a predicted-sign interval rule, where [0, 0] lies on neither side of zero; HELD for Q0b's inclusion rule, where [0, 0] includes zero. An exact zero is always labelled exactly zero (identical episodes, or not identical where the episodes differ) and is never offered as evidence for a predicted sign. For I, identical episodes means both pairs' (identical_pairs and identical, each pair by att_rederivation.contrast_discriminability; BRIEF_45 Amendment B.1, B.1.2(1))
definitions.interval: dt_gate.mean_ci95 over the per-draw differences: ddof=1, half-width 1.96 * sd / sqrt(n); low = mean - half-width, high = mean + half-width, width = high - low

not_registered.text: No level prediction for the two 4-head cells (§4.0.1).

outcomes.conjunction: a statement registered on all three or four tiers is HELD iff every tier is HELD, FAILED iff any tier is FAILED, NOT RESOLVED otherwise (BRIEF_45 section 3.3)
outcomes.interval: HELD / FAILED / NOT RESOLVED by the side of zero the CI lies on relative to the predicted sign (spatial_mixing._outcome_from_interval); a CI touching zero is NOT RESOLVED
outcomes.q0_stop_rule: STOP iff the CI of mean(d4) lies entirely below zero (tier_sweep.stop_rule_verdict)
outcomes.q3c: no verdict: a value per tier and P5.2b's reading (for / against the DT, NOT RESOLVED)
outcomes.q6: COLLAPSED iff the arm is worse than the shared anchor with the paired CI excluding 0, else NOT COLLAPSED; P5.1's three-valued outcome beside it (collapse_criterion)

definitions.paired_unit: per draw, the mean over the five training seeds (dt_gate._per_draw_means), over the identical (seed, draw) grid of two complete cells; differences per draw in ascending draw order
definitions.per_seed: every two-arm contrast carries tier_sweep.per_seed_block (P5.1's per_seed_advantages and seed_reversal_qualifier), and I carries the same worker over composite rows (BRIEF_45 Amendment B, B2.2); for the behaviour and random-anchor cells a seed label is an evaluation label, not a training seed
definitions.reverses_on_n_seeds: per_seed.reverses_on_n_seeds (P5.1's per_seed_advantages) is the size of the seed minority by sign, where only a negative value favours the left arm, so a seed whose value is exactly zero is counted with the seeds that do not favour it and the minority can be made of zero seeds; per_seed.reverses_against_pooled_sign counts the seeds whose sign opposes the pooled mean's and never an exactly-zero seed, and it -- with seed_reversal_qualifier, emitted from it -- is the field that qualifies a stated ordering (BRIEF_45 Amendment D, D1.5)

rule_r.fired: on grid4x4, by P8.4b's gate (docs/data/p8_4b_g0_reference.json); recorded in PROJECT_PLAN section 10 under its dated heading of 2026-08-31

quotes.text: PASS on S: `att_engine` is the primary metric for every claim on S, and `att_ours` is reported beside it in every table with the three counts.
both verdicts are reported whether or not they agree.
Every reported ATT cell carries, unconditionally, all five of `att_ours`, `att_engine`, `entered`, `created` and `never_entered`, re-derived by deterministic replay.

rule_r.reporting: every statement under both definitions; primary marks att_engine's entry; definition_dependent marks where the two verdicts (or readings) differ

quotes.text: TIE-BREAK RULE, declared 2026-08-24 after `fixedtime` produced two EXACT ties
A tie is scored as DISCORDANT for both orders: neither arm is placed ahead of the other, so a predicted ordering between two tied arms cannot be credited.
Under the rule declared here the count is the lower end, 7 of 18, and the range must travel with it.

ties.rule: exactly equal levels are not an ordering; Q3a's rank is 1 + the arms strictly lower; every tie-dependent integer carries its range over all tie-break orders

paired_comparison.p_value_note: two-sided signed-rank test (the normal approximation, with the tie and continuity corrections); it is never read by a verdict, and its z is computed from min(W+, W-), so the sign of z is not the direction of the difference -- read mean_difference's sign or the rank-biserial's instead (BRIEF_45 Amendment B.2, B.2.3)
paired_comparison.rank_biserial_note: (W+ - W-) / (W+ + W-) over the per-draw differences; positive means the left arm's ATT is higher (worse) more often and by larger ranks
paired_comparison.source: offline_baselines.paired_comparison, unchanged (D8); its mean_difference, ci95_low and ci95_high equal this block's under ==

definitions.reverses_against_pooled_sign: seeds whose sign disagrees with the pooled mean's sign; this is the one that qualifies a stated ordering, and it can differ from the minority when a few large seeds outvote a numerous small-effect majority
definitions.reverses_on_n_seeds: size of the seed MINORITY by sign, whichever side that is

what_this_does_not_say: No new prediction: every registered value of Q1-Q5 -- Q1's and Q1b's levels, Q2's orderings and first places, Q3b's and Q3c's values, Q4's chain and Q5's values -- is an att_horizon (att_ours) value, registered before any att_engine number existed; under att_engine each is compared with att_engine measurements, and every entry carrying a registered value, Q1's and Q1b's predicted levels or Q2a's predicted first place says so in predictions_registered_on. Rule R' is not recomputed from att_engine inputs (BRIEF_45 section 2; Amendment D, D1.7).
No episode was rolled, no checkpoint loaded, no model trained or evaluated: every number is a recomputation of committed records read at their digests.
P5.2's statements stand as written in its packet; this artifact scores them by the registered rules beside them and names every difference in comparison_with_the_record.

Out of scope: P4.x, P5.1 and P5.3 statements (P8.4b's V1-V7 hold their registered verdicts), the E1 and I1/J1 envelopes (replicates carry no att_engine; att_rederivation.is_replicate_artifact), hz1x1 and cologne3.
No level prediction exists for the two 4-head cells and no equivalence verdict is made anywhere (D8).
D15's clause on arms whose distribution is visibly not unimodal is a visual judgement this artifact does not make: it reports each cell's median and IQR and no distributional comparison.
The rank-biserial and the Wilcoxon p-value are reported beside every two-arm contrast (D8) and are never read by a verdict; I, a difference of two differences, carries none.
Q3c registers a value per tier and no outcome rule: it is reported with its reading and no verdict.
The leaders block and the descriptive collapse audit are not registered statements.

P8.4b's att_engine values are pinned by its campaign's completeness, the per-row checks, the README note's means on every tier and provenance.p8_4b_rows.sha256 -- not by a manifest P8.4b wrote, which does not exist.
Rule R makes att_engine the primary metric on grid4x4; the att_ours verdict is reported beside every one and definition_dependent marks where they differ.

definition_dependent compares verdicts (readings where an entry has no verdict): Q0b's sign and Q4b's chain shape are reported per definition beside the flag, and the flag does not compare them (BRIEF_45 Amendment B, B2.13).
